ownRead.description: Magnetically driven objects organize through their motion and fluid-mediated interactions.
ownRead.researchEdition: RRG v0.2.1 repository current; audited companion 2026-10-02; promoted 2026-10-05
ownRead.statement:
## E12 — Dynamic self-assembly of magnetized, millimetre-sized objects rotating at a liquid–air interface

**experiment · partial bridge · claims C3, C4.**

**Reported result:** Magnetically driven objects organize through their motion and fluid-mediated interactions.

**Already supplied:** Fabricated magnetic objects, liquid interface and rotating external field are provided.

**Limit of the RRG connection:** The result connects maintained activity and spatial arrangement. It does not imply all stable structures need continuous external driving.

**Source:** Grzybowski, Stone & Whitesides (2000), *Nature 405, 1033–1036*. [DOI: 10.1038/35016528](https://doi.org/10.1038/35016528).

**Verification coverage:** Publisher abstract and bibliographic record. Checked 2026-10-02.
